datedPicks.title: Mini-museum hunt! 50 years of Aardman
datedPicks.location: Bristol Museum & Art Gallery, Queens Road, Bristol BS8 1RL
datedPicks.description: Free family detective trail: pick up a map and hunt tiny Aardman treasures hidden around the galleries. Organiser page lists the trail 13 Feb–1 Nov 2026 (not a short summer-only run).
datedPicks.ageSuitability: DoNext fit: ages 0–12 with an adult. Check the organiser’s age guidance before booking.
datedPicks.appeal: Free family detective trail: pick up a map and hunt tiny Aardman treasures hidden around the galleries. Organiser page lists the trail 13 Feb–1 Nov 2026 (not a short summer-only run).
datedPicks.parentTip: Drop-in, no booking. Separate paid Aardman exhibition at M Shed is frequently sold out — this free hunt is at BMAG only.
